We had a pleasant journey at Rob’s flat.
The flat was as described, clean and well furnished
The flat is 5 minutes walk from the train station and then you can join the center of London in 10 minutes by the train.
100 % value for money. Thomasin as a host was extremely responsive about any queries I had. Would definitely book again for any future travels to London.

I really enjoyed my stay at Femi's apartment. Extremely clean and comfortable, and in a nice quiet area of London. Femi was very accommodating and friendly at check in
Would definitely stay again!

Dominic’s place was great! The communication was amazing and the place was very clean. The breakfast items he provided were very helpful and a nice touch. The location was great, walking distance from the tube in a very nice area. Would recommend to anyone who visits London! No complaints!

Very nice little flat perfect for a small family in a quiet area.
We had some noice during the first night on a terrasse in another flat but Louise was super reactive when we shared our concern and it was well managed.
Bathroom was pretty small for us but for few days we managed it.
Beds were too hard / overly firm (mattress and pillows) for us but it is a question of preference.
Overall very good choice, well located in a calm and green area with several bakeries or restaurants close by. Louise was very practice and always available.
Great stay in Clapham. Close to tube and buses. The flat looks exactly like the pictures and is very clean!

I stayed in Rachels bnb for 18 days, and i found everything about it wonderful.
Excellent area, short walk to the bus and the beautiful parks .
Loft style bedsitter , comfortable bed, small kitchen and roomy bathroom.
Fresh air and lots of sun making it a very inviting place to stay.
Thank you Rachel

Armel was so accommodating, kind, the house was immaculate and very clean. I was made very comfortable. He was very kind to leave a large bottle of water which I definitely needed with my late nights and thankfully a towel as I had forgotten mine!  I will definitely be coming back for a stay next time I’m in London.

The place was clean, nice, and looked exactly like the pictures. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout the stay. Added bonus: it has parking, which made things super convenient. Would definitely stay again!
Great communication with Azzam. The apartment is well positioned for public travel. Azzam is always available to help with any queries. Apartment is clean and has everything you need.
Good experience overall. Easy communication with the host, efficient clean appartment in convenient location. I would definitely stay here again.
Great value room in the best location. Very clean room. Thanks for having us and being so accomodating!

We had a lovely stay! great spot for public transportation, a lot of coffee shops and restaurants in the area and the street was quiet and clean as well!
right in the center of London without the clutter!

We all loved the place, location is fantastic and neighborhood very lively.
A great experience, thank you, Patrick.

The place was immaculate and very modern. The host was very accommodating. We were sitting outside eating our dinner and brought chairs from inside to sit on. He offered to bring over his patio furniture for us to sit on. He was very kind and accommodating! Only thing that could be helpful would be a long mirror to see your outfit ☺️…I’m on holiday/vacation😁.

The pros: Good location, near tube and train stations. Nice eateries nearby. Walking distance to Hyde Park. Host was also agreeable to late checkout.
The cons:
Cleaning needs improvement, a lot of rubbish found under sofa and bed.
It’s not quiet - at junction on main road and also right next to lift (can hear people slamming the lift doors every hour or so).
The hassle to collect keys 5mins walk away.
Also, we were told the en-suite bath is only half functional after booking.
Then there was also this instance where we were told a plumber will come inspect a leak on the first day of our stay, while we are out but with our belongings in the place.

Definitely worth it! Lots of amenities available for use, very happy with how there’s everything (dishwasher, seasoning etc… and the TV is awesome)
It is also close enough to city center but far away enough that there’s not much noise :)

Thank you for letting us stay in your lovely home!
The apartment itself is wonderful! Very lovely decor and had everything we needed! Really felt like a second home!
Max was wonderful and attentive! With very fast responses!
Wouldn’t hesitate to rent with Max again!
Thank you!!

Everything was great, except the Wifi and the second door. The Wifi did not work and the second door was terrible to get through. Otherwise it was all as expected. Safe and great stores all around you. Walking distance to the underground station.
Very clean and well presented but far too noisy by the main road. No blinds for the top floor room and curtains throughout the house of poor quality making it hard to sleep in summer months.
The photos do not do the place justice. It is massive!!! lovely place to stay. Right outside is a bus stop which was perfect. Highly recommend!

This place is fantastic!  The neighborhood was great and very walkable to lots of shops, restaurants and pubs.  We stayed here with family of 5 and the place was perfect.   The host was great and responsive although I only had to contact her once because everything went seamless.  Don't really have anything bad to say.
Place is exactly as listed, a good area with great transport links, close to both wembley and central london via tube. We had a lovely stay. Thank you!

Our family of 5 had a wonderful stay at Samir’s place! The apartment was really well set-up for a family, including comfortable beds & linens in both bedrooms, spotless bathrooms,and the sofa-bed in the very comfortable living room. The laundry & kitchen were also very helpful. We were comfortable throughout our two-night stay and really enjoyed walking in this neighborhood. Access to buses, grocery and restaurants was also very easy. We loved visiting Steven’s Garden and Victoria Park. Thanks to our host for great communication throughout!
I will  have nothing to say but utterly disappointed,  awaiting response from air B&B to deal with issues we our experienced ,
Great place. Located in an alleyway which is worth noting but close to transport links and well appointed.

We enjoyed our stay. It’s a great location, 10 minutes from the Parsons Green tube stop. Ekaterina was kind enough to let us check in earlier. Easy to find and clear instructions to get in. It is quite small but that’s clearly said in the description anyways. We had a great couple night stay, would definitely recommend :)

Tom’s place was great, and we would book it again during our next stay in London. The bed is comfortable, and it was great to have a kitchen and washing machine. The location was also great and central, near several neighborhoods and attractions, we walked everywhere! There are great cafes and restaurants right below the apartment. Tom was extremely responsive to our messages before and during our stay. For those used to American apartments, just a note that there is no elevator, and there are fans but no central AC. We loved our stay and would highly recommend it!

Great location with the well connected Kings Cross underground only a block away! Helpful host. The flat is spacious and clean, kitchen well equipped. Comfy bed.
The bedsofa in the living room is not fit for adults to sleep in, only lightweight children.

Stayed with my two brothers and our partners for an event in London. Easy to find, simple but had everything we needed, Paloma was very responsive and helpful. Only ten minute walk from Victoria coach station where we were able to store luggage before and after the stay. Would stay again (:
We had a great stay with Leah, super comfy bed and flat is in a great location. Leah is a friendly and interesting person, who helped us feel at home straight away. thank you Leah!

Lain's Place is great and meets all descriptions of the listing. The location is convenient between Heathrow Airport and London City Center in terms of transport and accessibility. It was a pleasure to stay there for a weekend Trip to London. I would not hesitate to recommend Lain's Place to friends.
Felt very welcome and the place was really nice! Friendly and attentive! Definitely recommend - thank you :)

James place was in a very beautiful, quiet, high end  of borough of London. We could easily find our way around and enjoyed the peaceful neighborhood after a long day of sightseeing. This isn't your "typical" Airbnb. It comes with a lot of character multiple levels and feels more like someone's current home than a sterile Airbnb. Warning that if you have young children you will be far from them as the bedrooms are two (short) floors apart with several wooden stairs. It was not an issue for us at all but would be a bit of a challenge if you were with a stroller/pram, walker or wheelchair.
Very beautiful home. I was quick in and out and it was what I needed. I would stay here again for sure.

This property was in the perfect location. Walkable to Kensington Gardens and Palace. Very safe and gorgeous area. Eitan was also helpful to allow us early check-in. We greatly appreciated it! My only suggestion is to offer a portable fan as the unit gets hot and we slept with the windows open, which in turn made for some noisier sleeps. All in all, the best location and a simple and clean space! Thank you Eitan!

The location was excellent — very convenient after subscription. Communication with the host was fast and helpful, and overall, the stay was quite comfortable. However, it was a bit noisy. The flat is on the second floor, and it’s easy to hear footsteps and sounds from the upstairs neighbor, especially at night. Sometimes they played loud music, which affected my sleep. It would also be better if the place provided a few more basic daily items.
